changelog:
Initial release of adobe-flue skill.

- Enables shell control of Adobe desktop apps (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, InDesign, Audition) via Flue.
- Executes ExtendScript in supported apps using a local stdin/stdout bridge for script automation and structured JSON output.
- Documents setup, safety guidelines, and usage scenarios for leveraging Adobe workflows from the shell.
- Notes support for additional creative and office apps (Blender, Houdini, 3ds Max, Unity, Microsoft Office) under the same mechanism.
display_name: Adobe - Agentic Control of Graphic Software
summary: Control Adobe desktop apps - Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, After Effects, InDesign, Audition - from the shell via Flue, without an MCP server.
